objective: Research an independent Core candidate with multiple daily detections, positive net mean and median, useful right-tail capture, bounded large losses, and no single-name/month/week dependence sufficient to explain the result.

per_signal_requirements: positive finite OHLC; high/low consistent with open/close; positive volume
current volume >= 5000 shares; preceding-session volume >= 10000 shares
at least one of the six frozen event rules fires
universe.missing_or_invalid_rows: Ineligible for candidate generation; no future outcome is consulted. The receipt records resulting event-pool rows and year counts, not a per-reason census of every excluded source row.

feature_contract.timestamp: Signal-date daily close; only bars dated at or before the signal date.
feature_contract.feature_source: Preserved daily OHLCV source; calculate with tvfree_screener.batch01.feature_panel.build_feature_panel and XTKS sessions.
transformations: volr5 and volr20 use the canonical current-inclusive panel features
volr10 is current volume divided by current-inclusive rolling 10-session mean volume and is used only when the last 10 XTKS sessions are consecutive source bars
rv_ratio is prior-session rolling-10 return volatility divided by prior-session rolling-40 return volatility
range_expansion is current range_pct divided by prior 10-session mean range_pct and is used only when those prior 10 sessions are consecutive source bars
break20 and break60 compare close with the preceding 20/60-session high, and are missing if any required XTKS session is absent
ret5, ret20, volr20 and pos60 are percentile-ranked cross-sectionally among same-day rows that pass the universe quality rules
forbidden: current or later revisions to signal-date values

events.evt_reversal: prev_ret5 <= -0.04 AND ret1 >= 0.01 AND close_loc >= 0.55 AND gap >= -0.06
events.evt_ignition: ret5 in [0.02, 0.15] AND ret1 >= 0.015 AND volr20 >= 1.10 AND pos60 >= 0.50 AND close_loc >= 0.55
events.evt_breakout: break20 in [0.00, 0.08] AND volr20 in [1.0, 5.0] AND close_loc >= 0.60
events.evt_gap_hold: gap in [0.01, 0.12] AND ret1 > 0 AND close_loc >= 0.60
events.evt_compression_release: rv_ratio <= 1.0 AND range_expansion >= 1.15 AND ret1 >= 0.015 AND volr20 >= 1.10 AND close_loc >= 0.55
events.evt_pullback_resume: ret20 >= 0.08 AND prev_ret5 <= 0.0 AND ret1 >= 0.015 AND pos60 >= 0.50
events.union_rule: A row is eligible when one or more rules fire; all fired event flags and event_count are retained.

target.entry: Next XTKS session open after signal close.
target.exit: Fifth XTKS session close after signal date.
target.return: exit_price / entry_price - 1; use existing build_labels_for_eligible_signals implementation and its unresolved status handling.
target.purge: At each model fit date, every training label must have exit_date strictly before the prediction period start.

heads.return_quality: Ridge linear regression on gross return clipped to [-0.30, 0.50].

model.implementation: Deterministic NumPy ridge; standardize with training-period means and scales only; clip standardized features to [-10, 10]; alpha=30; fixed closed-form solve; no external model runtime or network dependency.
model.score_scale: Convert each prediction head to same-signal-day percentile ranks over the full eligible event pool before combining.

selection.qualifying_names_per_day: Up to five; multiple names/day are allowed. Select all above the fixed variant gate, sorted by score descending then symbol ascending, truncated to five.
selection.cooldown: A selected symbol is suppressed on the immediately following XTKS session; it may qualify again from session+2.
selection.calendar: Frozen official XTKS session calendar; weekends and exchange holidays are not sessions.
selection.empty_day: No selection; abstention remains in daily-cohort metrics.

evaluation.data_access: Read features and labels only through the 2024-12-30 purge cutoff. Stream raw rows and filter by date text before parsing; 2025+ numeric OHLCV is not parsed.
evaluation.variant_choice: Only variants passing all fixed gates in both halves are eligible. Select the eligible variant with maximum predeclared robust_utility; do not change formula, gate or model after seeing results.
reported_metrics: complete daily cohorts and block bootstrap
evaluation.concentration_warning: No variant is promoted on one top symbol, one best month, mean alone, or a small sample. Monster-style right-tail tolerance is not used to weaken this Core gate.

implementation_complexity: Six event rules, 29 features, three NumPy ridge heads, four fixed score variants, two 2024 half-year refits, and no extra Python package or production integration.

phases.current: Register and test implementation, generate feature-only event pool, commit pool receipt, independently reproduce and commit its report, then open only 2024 outcome labels.
phases.2025: Closed. If a 2024 variant survives, first commit a separate fixed 2025 freeze; no result in this report alone authorizes opening 2025.
phases.2026: Report-only and closed for tuning or selection.
phases.promotion: Not eligible for promotion to production. A later independent frozen validation and same-definition comparison against V29/current benchmark are required.

known_limitations: All historical market periods have been viewed elsewhere in the broader research; this is retrospective evidence, not pristine OOS.
This source does not contain intraday execution order or limit-queue evidence; next-open fill is a proxy.
A five-name daily cap is a frozen research selection rule, not a production notification limit.
No V29 or current-bot result is pooled unless its canonical target, costs, sample, and entry timing are demonstrably identical.
